title: Take the Money: Closing the Bargain
label: ch:mw-final-price
canDo: I can ask for a final price and hand over the money, so that a purchase runs from asking to see a thing all the way to paying for it, without learning a new Devanagari sign.

payoff.summary: Take and give arrive as a one-beat pair, the word for final joins them, and the two closing lines of a purchase are scored separately in listening, speaking, reading, and writing.
